title: Better By The Beach | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set in the picturesque Camp District of Watercolor, this four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom vacation home epitomizes coastal luxury and comfort. Upon entering, guests are welcomed by a grand staircase leading to the upper floors, setting the tone for an exquisite stay. The main floor features a master bedroom with all-around windows, a luxurious soaking tub, and a walk-in shower that exemplifies relaxation. Beyond the master suite lies a kitchen and open living space, fully equipped with modern appliances and a double sink that simplifies meal preparations. The living room, adorned with multiple couches and a cozy fireplace, alongside a dining area that seats eight, creates a homely ambiance. An adjoining sunroom with views of the plunge pool and spa offers a serene retreat, complemented by a screened-in porch that also accesses the pool area. As visitors ascend to the second floor, they discover three additional bedrooms, each with private bathrooms, and a charming bunk nook with four beds, providing ample space for relaxation and privacy. A second living room on this floor presents a perfect gathering spot, complete with a balcony and a bed swing for leisurely enjoyment. The excitement continues to the third floor where a media room awaits, furnished with a TV and various seating arrangements for entertainment and socialization. This floor also includes a convenient half bathroom. The home’s crowning feature is a tower with a 360-degree view of Watercolor, offering an unparalleled perspective of the surrounding beauty, making this vacation home not just a place to stay, but a memorable experience of beachside living.
